'''Goniec''' started playing Quake offline in 2001 mostly playing with [[Image:flag_pl.gif]][[Tom]],  [[Image:flag_pl.gif]][[Hubo]],[[Image:flag_pl.gif]][[NICK]] and [[Image:flag_pl.gif]][[Toniu]] on LAN. After many local LANs played mainly in internet cafes and [[Image:flag_pl.gif]][[Tom]]'s house he moved to Poznan and had good internet connection for the first time. He started to play 4on4 in his first clan [[Image:flag_pl.gif]][[The Pimps]] and then in [[Image:flag_pl.gif]][[Boomstick Ownators]]. He has participated in many Polish LAN Parties and attended [[QHLAN]] twice. In 2009 he joined [[Image:flag_pl.gif]][[Demolition Crew]] to play a lot of 4on4s. In 2012 started the longest QuakeWorld break due to family and work issues. Back in 2019 and played for fun with the old crew. Organizer of [[QW LAN Party Poland 2021]].
